batchId: Claude manual-research batch games-missing (14 identities that had no profile)
method: Facts taken from fetched pages (mostly Wikipedia and Tolkien Gateway, plus search-result articles); claims a page did not support were left out. No numeric tiers. All records provisional until a different contributor checks them.

characters.continuity: Half-Life series (Half-Life 2, its episodes and Half-Life: Alyx).
characters.summary: Resistance fighter and Gordon Freeman's main ally. She fights alongside him, gives him the gravity gun and works with her robot, Dog.

techniques: Killed the Advisor that threatened her father

mechanisms: Not established by the cited sources

weaknesses: Gravely wounded by a Combine Hunter
Captured at the Citadel

characters.summary: Disgraced Covenant Elite commander made Arbiter after failing to stop the destruction of Halo; later an ally of humanity.
